title: Africa–Asia iridium, osmium, and ruthenium exports
note: Iridium, osmium and ruthenium, unwrought or in powder form (HS 711041), and iridium, osmium and ruthenium in other semi-manufactured forms (HS 711049). The two codes are stored separately and must not be added. Each code is a combined customs category for iridium, osmium, and ruthenium. A stored row is not iridium alone, not osmium alone, and not ruthenium alone. Reporter exports to the other region only. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade. A missing code or year is not zero and must not be filled from the other code, from another year, or from another reporter. Customs weight is kilograms, not troy ounces, and is not a platinum, palladium, or rhodium price. Net weight and quantity can both be kilograms and still differ; they must not be substituted. A null net weight is not zero. Quantity 0 with unit code -1 is not a measured kilogram weight. This is not the HS 7110 heading. It is not platinum (HS 711011 or HS 711019), not palladium (HS 711021 or HS 711029), not rhodium (HS 711031 or HS 711039), not precious-metal ores (HS 2616), not waste and scrap (HS 7112), not jewelry (HS 7113), not gold (HS 7108), and not silver (HS 7106). Mine production is absent from this database, not zero. The Pink Sheet has no iridium, osmium, or ruthenium series, so no price is stored. The stored platinum benchmark is not this customs unit value. A Comtrade preview on 2026-11-12 before collection, reporter 710, showed South Africa unwrought HS 711041 to Japan in 2024 at USD 461,784,446.407 with both weight fields 7,879.71 kg, unit code 8. The same preview for 2023 is USD 281,096,020.009 and both weight fields 4,466.43 kg. For 2025 it is USD 396,455,132.054 and both weight fields 6,814.51 kg. The years differ, so they must not be substituted. South Africa semi-manufactured HS 711049 to Japan in 2024 is USD 80,477,800.028 and both weight fields 2,917.32 kg. In 2023 it is USD 89,298,202.035 and both weight fields 1,800.99 kg. In 2025 it is USD 110,202,300.539 and both weight fields 2,828.62 kg. Within each of those code-years the net weight and quantity use unit code 8 and match. South Africa unwrought HS 711041 to India in 2023 is USD 1,734,512.6 and both weight fields are 134.13 kg. In 2024 it is USD 355,742.369, under USD 1 million, and is not stored. In 2025 it is USD 60,804.543 and is not stored. Those years must not be substituted. South Africa unwrought HS 711041 to the United Arab Emirates in 2024 was USD 1,389.791 and is not stored. South Africa semi-manufactured HS 711049 to the United Arab Emirates in 2025 was USD 302.208 and is not stored. Collected 2026-11-12: 312/312 reporter-years ok, none truncated, 19 kept flows (7 in 2023, 6 in 2024, 6 in 2025). 13 are HS 711041 and 6 are HS 711049. All 19 are South Africa to Asia. No Asia-to-Africa flow reached USD 1 million. Every kept row has quantity equal to net weight, unit code 8. Zimbabwe, the United Arab Emirates, Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, and Singapore returned no rows in 2023, 2024, and 2025. China 2023 and India 2023 returned no rows. China 2024 returned HS 711041 to South Africa at USD 308,700 and both weight fields 18 kg, unit code 8. China 2025 returned HS 711041 to South Africa at USD 2,890 and both weight fields 20 kg, unit code 8. India 2024 returned HS 711049 to Botswana at USD 33.17 and both weight fields 1 kg, and HS 711049 to Nigeria at USD 10.566 with a net weight of 0, not null, and quantity 0, unit code 8. India 2025 returned HS 711041 to South Africa at USD 204.657 and both weight fields 0.005 kg, unit code 8. Rwanda 2024 returned HS 711041 to China at USD 21,766.2, with a null net weight and quantity 0, unit code -1. Each of those rows is under USD 1 million and is not stored. The South Africa to Japan 2024 rows were re-fetched after the database build and matched.
